unnumbered.review: Reviewed main-body PUBLISH headers, property types/contexts and actions. Broker decode_for_inner bounds property blocks, rejects singleton repeats, checks PFI0/1 and nonzero alias, distinguishes text/binary, and rejects Subscription Identifier on client ingress. Unknown/context-illegal properties are malformed; duplicate singletons are protocol errors. StoredMessage and encode_publish_with_subscription_ids preserve metadata and ordered repeated User Properties. Client CLI validates generated properties and main checks PFI1 payload UTF8; receiver payload-format validation is MAY. Client PublishProperties::read overwrites singleton repeats and omits PFI-range/full MQTT text checks; its cursor walks the enclosing frame rather than a sliced property buffer. Default client auto-ACK precedes CLI application validation. Broker aliases are independently scoped by direction; client dependency reconnect state retains its alias map. Generic rumqttc reconnect alias/DUP hazards are dependency-only: CLI poll-error paths exit, and reuse of that state across a reachable CLI connection change was not established.
unnumbered.limitations: Static inspection only. Bounds are finite project quotas (topic1024,payload4096,packet64KiB,property fields256,16pairs/2048bytes), not a claim to accept every permitted protocol value. Singleton/context negatives in the dependency need independent probes. No bridge workflow certification. Main-body MQTT-3.3.1-10 prevails over inverted Appendix B wording. Generic reconnect/pending/control-window hazards are EVIDENCE_GAP for CLI integration, not demonstrated product deviations; CLI durable outbox recovery is distinct.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed PUBACK fixed flags, identifier/reason layout, compact success forms, reason table, singleton Reason String, repeated User Property, no-payload rule and diagnostic size prohibition. Broker decode_client_publish_ack excludes server-only No Matching Subscribers on client ingress, checks nonzero ID, exact body end and diagnostics context; outgoing success/ACL negatives omit diagnostics. Client PubAck reason enum covers the table and compact serializer forms; normal automatic acknowledgment uses properties=None. PubAckProperties::read accepts repeated Reason String by replacement; Packet::read dispatches on packet type and does not enforce every reserved low-bit flag. Client code does not semantically parse diagnostic prose.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only; sender reason/size support does not establish complete client receive validation. Negative reserved-flag, singleton and property-boundary coverage is not inferred from source test names.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed PUBREC fixed header, compact success forms, allowed reasons, diagnostics contexts and no-payload layout. Broker uses decode_client_publish_ack for client PUBREC and rejects client No Matching Subscribers; outgoing Success/Not Authorized/Quota Exceeded are valid reasons. Negative incoming PUBREC selects RecRejected and ends that outbound copy; positive PUBREC persists AwaitPubComp before PUBREL. Client PubRec enum serializer emits permitted reasons and normal replies omit diagnostics; generic property reading overwrites repeated Reason String and lacks the broker's full semantic validation.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Table restriction0x10 is direction-sensitive. Dependency receive error handling/duplicate reasons require independent vectors; no claim of comprehensive QoS2 behavior from this packet's sender rows.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed PUBREL flags0010, nonzero identifier, success/not-found reasons, optional compact variable-header forms, Reason String/User Property contexts and absent payload. Broker decode_qos2_completion_ack allows0x00/0x92 and ends exactly at body boundary; encode_pubrel emits compact Success with correct flags. Actor::pubrel removes accepted inbound state atomically and serve_mqtt sends PUBCOMP even when that ID is no longer present. Client PubRel serializer emits correct flags and typed reasons; MqttState::handle_incoming_pubrel requires a recorded ID and can fail a repeated PUBREL instead of returning PUBCOMP (cross-reference4.3.3).
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Repeated PUBREL state behavior belongs also to the operational QoS2 audit; diagnostic duplicate/context limitations remain in vendored readers. No complete QoS2 certification.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed PUBCOMP flags0000, compact Success forms, Packet Identifier, reason set0x00/0x92, permitted diagnostics and absence of payload. Broker decoder validates identifier/flags/body end; outgoing encoder omits properties. Client PubComp enum/read/write implements the table and normal replies omit diagnostics; PubCompProperties::read permits repeated Reason String by replacement and uses a consumed-byte counter over the frame. The default client's repeated-PUBREL path is not established by a correct PUBCOMP serializer.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Correct generated ACK syntax is separate from transaction completion, duplicate reception and unexpected IDs. No arbitrary caller-supplied diagnostics are certified.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed SUBSCRIBE property contexts (one nonzero Subscription Identifier and repeatable User Property), at least one pair, QoS/NL/RAP/RH options, reserved bits, ordinary replacement, shared establishment and identifier persistence/removal. Broker decode_for_inner rejects illegal properties/repeats, options QoS3/RH3/reserved6/7/sharedNL; update_subscription stores the identifier or removes an old one when absent; shared establishment deliberately skips retained replay. CLI validates outgoing options/shared filters; Filter::write emits only defined bits. Vendored SubscribeProperties::read can replace repeated identifiers and does not reject zero, but it is not an active Server parser in this Client role.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Semantic labels of QoS3/RH3 errors are Protocol Error in main body; broker generic closure was inspected but reason-specific wire emission was not executed here. SUBACK-before-PUBLISH ordering is permitted, not required. Dependency receiving SUBSCRIBE does not become an applicable Client obligation.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed SUBACK reserved flags, identifier, empty/singleton/repeated diagnostics contexts, reason-table values and one reason per request filter in order. Broker emits valid per-filter0/1/2/0x87 with empty properties. Client SubAck::read requires nonempty reasons and validates each reason enum; CLI subscribe checks reason count. CLI treats a lower granted QoS than requested as an application failure even though that grant is protocol-valid. SubAckProperties::read replaces duplicate Reason String and generic Packet::read does not fully validate reserved flags.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Client reason-count checks do not prove Packet Identifier correlation: the inspected subscribe branch accepts the first SUBACK while !acknowledged without comparing its ID to the emitted request. Diagnostics are not used as machine-readable decisions.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed UNSUBSCRIBE flags0010, nonzero ID, only repeated User Property in its property context, one-or-more UTF8 filters, exact deletion and retained in-progress transaction obligations. Broker decode_for_inner validates fields/context, Actor::unsubscribe removes only exact filter and associated options/IDs/shared membership, preserves existing outbound/offline entries, and sends one result per filter. Client unsubscribe_after_count sends one previously validated filter per request; optional repeated User Properties use their permitted context.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. Continuing buffered preexisting deliveries after unsubscribe is permitted; clearing future subscription-based routing is distinct from dropping an already-started QoS transaction. No concurrency or crash scenarios executed here.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed UNSUBACK flags0000, echoed ID, reason0x00/0x11 and allowed error reasons, ordered reason vector, diagnostic singleton/repeat contexts and maximum packet size. Broker emits ordered per-filter results and empty properties. Client UnsubAck::read maps every reason through its table and CLI expects one reason for its one-filter requests; the CLI treats No Subscription Existed as unsuccessful user intent although it is a valid protocol response. Reason String duplicate/context parsing remains weaker in the vendored reader.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. unsubscribe_after_count does not compare acknowledgment Packet Identifier with the request's identifier; count validation alone is insufficient proof of complete correlation. Unknown property, extra-byte and duplicated diagnostic vectors were not executed here.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed exact case-sensitive level matching, '+' matching one level including empty, '#' matching parent and descendants, leading/trailing separators, dollar namespace exception, length/NUL constraints, and no Unicode normalization. Broker topic::validate_filter/matches_filter_counted implement these semantics with original strings. Shared matching delegates to the validated inner filter. CLI outbound names/filters use its validation and rumqttc wildcard validation; cli::matches_filter independently handles display exclusions. Incoming NUL topic acceptance is an observed Client receive-validation gap; it does not demonstrate invalid Client emission. Section4.13.1 recommends Client closure using SHOULD, so this recipient behavior is not labeled a mandatory sender breach.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only. The1024-byte project quota proves a narrower upper bound; no universal acceptance of all65535-byte strings is claimed. The separate SHOULD discourage dollar-topic exchange is policy-dependent and no universal implementation/rationale was established. The controlled-peer NUL report's FAIL is preserved as an observation against the harness rejection expectation, not generalized into mandatory sender nonconformance.

unnumbered.review: Reviewed ordinary/shared distinction, full $share/group/filter identity, group independence even with equal ShareName, single chosen member per group, no initial retained delivery, persistent offline membership, last-member removal, QoS1 redistribution recommendation, QoS2 binding and negative-ACK discard. apply_shared_deliveries chooses one member using an independent complete-filter cursor; subscribe_with_shared skips retained for shared filters; unsubscribe removes membership; reassign_ended_shared_qos1 reassigns only QoS1 after the chosen Session ends. QoS2 remains owned by the selected DurableSession and is not transferred. Selection fairness is an implementation choice, not a universal MQTT fairness guarantee.
unnumbered.limitations: Static only; finite quotas, ACL removal and storage failures constrain acceptance. No cross-broker cluster/shared balancing or bridge workflow certification; client merely sends validated shared subscriptions and does not implement Server distribution. Recommendation support does not convert a SHOULD into a MUST.

findings.summary: Dependency-only reconnect hazard: clean/outgoing_publish/generic EventLoop replay can preserve the original DUP=false. Active CLI poll-error paths terminate the operation; durable_publish sets DUP explicitly. CLI reachability of the generic reconnect replay was not established.
findings.next_action: Before any product-deviation claim, demonstrate a reachable CLI path that reconnects the same EventLoop with an unacknowledged stored publication. Otherwise retain this as a dependency integration gap and separately assess the generic library API; no probe executed by this reviewer.

findings.summary: Dependency-only reconnect hazard: MqttState::clean leaves topic_alises populated, but the CLI exits on poll failure and creates a fresh EventLoop for a new run. A retained map across a reachable CLI Network Connection change was not established. The original incoming event clone is also distinct from the dependency's internal topic mutation.
findings.next_action: Require a reachable CLI reconnect trace before asserting a product alias-lifetime violation. A generic library reuse probe may characterize the dependency but must stay labeled as such; no probe executed by this reviewer.

findings.summary: Dependency-only pending-replay hazard: generic EventLoop::select permits pending PUBLISH despite inflight_full. CLI normal publishing is sequential and poll failures terminate its operation; no CLI reconnect carrying multiple pending publications under a smaller maximum was established.
findings.next_action: Establish real CLI reachability before claiming Receive Maximum violation. Preserve the static generic-library hazard and examine any future integration that reuses EventLoop across errors; no probe executed by this reviewer.

findings.summary: Dependency-only request-gating hazard: generic EventLoop::select gates requests_rx wholesale when the publication window is full. The active CLI completes its publication before queuing disconnect, and no CLI path queuing a non-PUBLISH control while its outgoing publication window is full was demonstrated.
findings.next_action: Require a concrete CLI request schedule under a full outgoing window before calling this a product deviation. Keep the generic library scheduling concern as an integration evidence gap; no probe executed by this reviewer.

findings.summary: Receive-validation/hardening gap: the coordinator's controlled peer sent an invalid NUL Topic Name; the ordinary CLI accepted/displayed it and exited0.
